requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing strong encryption for all member data.
The system shall ensure that only authenticated members can borrow or return books through a unified authentication process.
The system shall provide timely digital notifications of overdue books to minimize paper waste and promote responsibility.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing and ensure operational safety.
The system shall allow up to 5 simultaneous book borrow operations per member to optimize resource utilization.
The system shall track and report energy usage quarterly to promote sustainability in library operations.
The system shall implement energy-efficient servers to minimize energy consumption in library operations.
The system shall log all user actions related to book borrowing and returning for accountability.
The system shall allow librarians to manage member accounts, including revoking borrowing privileges for overdue books.
The system shall enable real-time updates for book availability to ensure accurate information.
